concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-partners-oauth-installed-oauth-apps]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Customer Area route for merchant-account-specific app consent, Merchant-admin view/uninstall and immediate access invalidation; no actual grant or revoke proof.
warnings: The page says uninstall invalidates all active access but does not distinguish access and refresh token handling or define an API revocation endpoint.
App creation is partner-only in this page; customer view/revoke requires company-account access and Merchant admin role.
